obfuscation_indicators: ordering cycle of a large customer
risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative disclosure, but results show declining sales, persistent net and operating losses, sharply reduced gross margins, inventory-obsolescence exposure, customer concentration, and pricing pressure. Liquidity appears adequate, with no credit-line borrowings and stated borrowing capacity, although the assessment relies partly on management projections and includes standard forward-looking and reserve-adequacy caveats.
